en.title: After‑School Bugs, Your Will, and Strawberry Shortcake
en.premise: After school, while hanging out in the park, I pick up a tiny lost AI—a self‑floating autonomous device. Together with the silent boy who seems to be its owner, Ren, we begin a journey to locate the AI’s “home.” But hidden inside the AI is someone’s “last will”! As we chase the wandering AI, the gap between me and Ren slowly sweetens and shrinks, just like a bite of strawberry shortcake.

zh.title: 放学后的Bug、你的遗言与草莓奶油蛋糕
zh.premise: 放学后在公园里，我捡到了一只迷路的小型AI（自律型浮游装置）。看似是它主人、沉默的少年蓮くん和我一起，踏上寻找这只AI“归宿”的旅程。但这只AI内部竟隐藏着某人的“遗言”！在追寻迷路AI的过程中，我和蓮くん的距离也像甜点一样，慢慢缩短，变得甜蜜。

prediction_results.reason: ルルのハッキングによるトラブルが物語の急展開として描かれているため。

prediction_results.question: ルルのデータが書き換えられ、激しい閃光が走った後、何が起こる？
